findings.title: Cookie 'PHPSESSID' missing HttpOnly flag
findings.description: JavaScript on the page can read this cookie, so an XSS bug can steal it.
findings.recommendation: Add the HttpOnly attribute to the Set-Cookie header.

findings.title: Cookie 'auth_token' missing HttpOnly flag
findings.description: JavaScript on the page can read this cookie, so an XSS bug can steal it.
findings.recommendation: Add the HttpOnly attribute to the Set-Cookie header.

findings.title: Cookie 'auth_token' uses SameSite=None without Secure
findings.description: Browsers reject SameSite=None cookies that are not Secure, and it widens cross-site exposure.

findings.title: Page can be framed (clickjacking)
findings.description: Another site can load this page in an invisible frame and trick visitors into clicking buttons on it.
findings.recommendation: Add X-Frame-Options: DENY (or SAMEORIGIN), or CSP frame-ancestors 'self'.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy
findings.description: Without a CSP, any script injected into a page (XSS) runs with no browser-side limits.

findings.title: Cookie 'theme' missing HttpOnly flag
findings.description: JavaScript on the page can read this cookie, so an XSS bug can steal it.
findings.recommendation: Add the HttpOnly attribute to the Set-Cookie header.

findings.title: Cookie 'PHPSESSID' missing SameSite
findings.description: Without SameSite, other sites may trigger requests that carry this cookie (CSRF).

findings.title: Cookie 'theme' missing SameSite
findings.description: Without SameSite, other sites may trigger requests that carry this cookie (CSRF).

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
findings.description: Browsers may guess file types and run an upload as a script.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy
findings.description: Full page URLs (which can contain tokens or IDs) may be sent to other sites.

findings.title: Server header reveals a software version
findings.description: Attackers can look up known vulnerabilities for the exact version.
findings.recommendation: Hide the version (Apache: ServerTokens Prod, nginx: server_tokens off).

findings.title: x-powered-by header reveals the technology stack
findings.description: This tells attackers which framework and version to target.
findings.recommendation: Remove the x-powered-by header (PHP: expose_php = Off).

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy
findings.description: Browser features like camera, microphone and geolocation are not explicitly limited.
